03 · Skills
Technical Skills
Software Development
Proficient in Python, C++, and C; familiar with Git and Shell; working knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. Experienced in Flask and Streamlit prototyping, GitHub deployment, API integration, video-stream processing, multiprocessing, real-time pipelines, and end-to-end engineering integration.
AI / Deep Learning
Completed Huawei's HCIA-AI coursework; familiar with PyTorch model training and deployment, with practical computer-vision experience using YOLO and OpenCV. Participated in VLA and embodied-intelligence projects; familiar with Stable Diffusion and TensorFlow, with hands-on experience in CNNs, RNNs, and time-series analysis.
Simulation and Toolchains
Familiar with Blender, Unity, and MATLAB, with experience in simulation-scene construction, UI design, and web development.
Data Processing
Experienced in time-series modeling and analysis; familiar with pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, SQL, and Python web scraping for data processing, visualization, and information-system prototyping.
04 · Projects
Selected Projects
GitHub Profile →
research.hachile.org →
National Undergraduate Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program · Lead Planner
Southwest Building 1 Digital Twin Platform
Built a future-college community platform for Southwest Building 1 using the infrastructure digital base developed by Academician Zhu Hehua's team and Tongji University's iS3 Lab. I led proposal development, team recruitment, laboratory and faculty coordination, plan writing, API applications, Blender 3D modeling, cloud-server evaluation and deployment, and UI design. The project was later approved as a national-level undergraduate innovation project.
GitHub: DROM →
Independent Development
IASR System: Integrated Air Situation Recognition System
Processes video for object detection and tracking, calculates traffic-situation indicators and congestion indices, estimates visibility from video clarity, emits events in a unified format, and routes them to operations, security, emergency response, or traffic-management recipients according to configuration. The project received third prize at Guohao College's 3rd “Yanxue Jihao” Poster Exhibition.
GitHub: Main Repository → Cloud Version → Legacy Version →
National Undergraduate Innovation and Entrepreneurship Training Program · Team Member
AegisDrive: World-Model-Assisted Minimum-Risk Decision System for Autonomous-Driving Failures
Uses a dual-track architecture combining in-cabin monitoring and external perception. Eye and mouth geometry rules determine driver state, while a lightweight YOLOv8n model performs vehicle detection and monocular ranging. A world-model-based pipeline processes two video streams concurrently with Python multiprocessing and issues real-time warnings. I developed the in-cabin facial-recognition component and contributed to project documentation. The project won second prize in the freshman division of the 25th Tongluren Transportation Science and Technology Competition, was upgraded to a national-level undergraduate innovation project, and received a silver award in the Tongji University round of the 9th China International College Students' Innovation Competition.
GitHub: AegisDrive → GitHub: IDMS →
SITP Team Member · Embodied Intelligence
QDepth-VLA: Lightweight Vision Models for Orchard Harvesting
Generates pseudo-depth with a monocular depth model, discretizes it into depth tokens through a VQ-VAE, and injects geometric information into the VLA backbone through a Depth Expert and Hybrid Attention. Using only a standard RGB camera, the project validates a closed-loop recognition–localization–harvesting prototype in simulation and on a desktop robotic arm. I handled early literature research, faculty and laboratory coordination, harvesting-method analysis, and robotic-arm development. The work combines two SITP undergraduate innovation projects and is competing in the 15th Challenge Cup Chinese College Students' Entrepreneurship Competition.
Independent Development · Time-Series Analysis
Multimodal Cockpit Seat-Pressure Analysis System
Analyzes pressure trends, stability indicators, and temporal features in cockpit seat-pressure sensor data across different body-weight groups, providing data support for seat-design optimization and ergonomics research. Uses pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib for data processing, numerical computation, and visualization.
GitHub Repository →
Development Team Member · Data Systems
Global University Faculty Information System
Proposed and supported with data by the APJIE journal at the Shanghai International College of Intellectual Property. Built with Python web scraping and an SQL database, the system supports queries by age, institution, research output, and other dimensions.
GitHub Repository →
First Author · Manuscript Under Review
AI-Based Analysis and Prediction of Lithium-Dendrite Growth in Lithium-Metal Batteries
Constructed a multimodal dataset containing scanning-electron-microscope images, electrochemical time series, and electrolyte and interface descriptors. Used CNNs for dendrite morphology recognition and grading, convolutional and recurrent neural networks to predict polarization voltage and overpotential fluctuations, and regression models to analyze relationships among electrolyte composition, transport properties, and dendrite growth, providing an interpretable screening approach for safer lithium-metal battery design.
GitHub: Lithium Dendrite Cellular Automata Simulator →
05 · Strengths
Personal Strengths
Academic Foundation
Won a provincial first prize in informatics during secondary school; scored 146 in English on the National College Entrance Examination and 550+ on CET-6. Participated in the Oxford Prospects Programme and the Hong Kong Polytechnic University Summer School, gaining experience in academic English communication.
Research and Innovation
Selected for Tongji University's “Innovation and Entrepreneurship+” pilot program and the Shanghai Angel Association University Youth Innovation Camp. Completed research internships at Tongji's XAI Lab Intelligent Experience Laboratory and iS3-Lab Digital Campus Scenario Laboratory, and contributed to the APJIE journal's big-data system. Participated in programs and events organized by Huawei, Tencent, Baidu, ByteDance, EY, Shanghai Innovation Institute, and Shenzhen Hetao College.
Leadership and Community Engagement
Founded and managed Guohao College discussion groups, competition groups, and an AI foundation-model community, and operated the Future Technology Program's WeChat public account. Experienced in community operations and public relations. Named a 2025 “Mingde Star” by Guohao College and nominated at university level for the Excellence Star Scholarship; received awards in photography, sports, writing, and public-speaking competitions. Completed more than 50 hours of university volunteer service and led an A-rated social-practice project.
